message.content: I've got chest pain that started while I was in the hospital getting treated for the blood infection. I'm not sure of all the details of the pain, to be honest. I know the infection is MRSA and that it got into my heart, and they're giving me antibiotics through an IV. I don't remember the exact names of the medicines or how many days I've been on them. I also get dialysis because my kidneys don't work.
